svg.text: Monorepo Tooling Architecture — LLD
Workspace Structure & Package Boundaries
Workspace layout: apps/, packages/, tools/, configs/ at root
Package types: app (deployable), lib (shared code), config (shared tooling)
Package naming: @org/ui, @org/utils, @org/api-client — scoped
Dependency rules: apps depend on libs; libs cannot depend on apps
Boundary enforcement: ESLint import rules / Nx module boundary rules
pnpm workspaces: hoisted deps at root; package-specific in node_modules
Shared configs: tsconfig.base.json, eslint.base.js — extend in each pkg
Changesets: track which packages changed; auto-generate changelogs
Build Caching & Task Orchestration
Turborepo: task graph from turbo.json; runs tasks in dependency order
Local cache: hash(inputs) → cache hit skips task entirely
Remote cache: Vercel Remote Cache / self-hosted — share across CI agents
Affected packages: turbo --filter=[...origin/main] runs only changed pkgs
Nx: project graph computation; task runner with remote cache (Nx Cloud)
Parallel execution: tasks without shared deps run concurrently
Pipeline: build → test → lint — task depends on upstream build output
Cache invalidation: input globs (src/**) + env vars determine cache key
Dependency Management & Versioning
Phantom dependencies: pnpm strict mode — only declared deps accessible
Peer deps: UI library declares React as peer; consuming app provides it
Version pinning: exact versions in lockfile; dependabot PRs for updates
Internal packages: workspace:* protocol — always uses local version
Cyclic deps: forbidden — linting catches circular imports between packages
Changesets workflow: changeset add → version → publish to npm
Release PR: automated bot opens PR bumping versions + changelogs
Pre-release: alpha/beta tags for testing new major versions in apps
CI/CD, Code Generation & DX
CI matrix: affected packages detected → parallel jobs per package
PR checks: lint + type-check + test only for affected packages
Deploy gates: deploy only changed apps; unchanged apps skip entirely
Code generation: hygen / plop templates for new package scaffolding
GraphQL codegen: run in CI; generated types committed to repo
Dev server: turbo dev --filter=app-name starts only needed packages
Storybook: shared component stories in @org/ui; single Storybook instance
When to split to polyrepo: 10+ independent teams, different deploy SLAs
pnpm workspaces: strict hoisting, no phantom deps
Turborepo cache: hash(inputs) → skip unchanged tasks
Affected-only CI: only changed packages build and test
Changesets: automated versioning and changelog PRs
Nx module boundaries: enforced import rules per package
